title: gflow~
description: `gflow~` is a synchronous granular system that granularizes audio from a table and outputs a stereo signal, with controls for grain size, pitch, position, envelope shape, panning, and stereo width. Its arguments specify the number of voices and an optional default table name; use `set` to select a table, while `beg`, `len`, and `speed` control how grain positions move through the sample.
